courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的鐵道與交通設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring railway and transport systems through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 列車自動防護系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「停準制動軌跡」與「速度閉迴路時序」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；列車自動防護系統的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Stopping brake trajectory" and "Speed-loop timing budget" transfer, while operating boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Automatic train protection systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦由速度規畫到停準驗證的自動駕駛閉迴路；列車自動防護系統則以制動包絡定位不確定度與失效保守狀態為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on automatic-driving feedback from speed planning to stopping verification; Automatic train protection systems centres on braking envelopes location uncertainty and conservative failure states, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「停準制動軌跡」與「常減速度停距」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到列車自動防護系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「資料新鮮度距離」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Stopping brake trajectory” and “Constant-deceleration stop distance”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Automatic train protection systems, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Data-age distance scale", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 列車自動駕駛系統
history.text: 本課以可查核的工程與方法出版歷程建立背景：2002 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法早期版發布。；2023 年歐盟列控技術規則二零二三號一六九五發布。；2025 年鐵路可靠度與安全方法第一分冊發布。這些日期分別是工程事件、指南重印或標準研究出版，並非宣稱本課系統在該年問世。對由速度規畫到停準驗證的自動駕駛閉迴路而言，歷史脈絡的價值是理解需求如何從單一設備擴展到跨介面證據。本課再用舒適加速度過渡及自動駕駛服務恢復連結這些方法；代表工程僅提供觀察方向，假想參數不冒充現場資料，歷史版規範也不自動等於當地現行要求。
history.textEn: The background uses checkable project events and methodological publication history. 2002: An early railway RAMS specification was published. 2023: European Commission Regulation twenty-twenty-three slash sixteen-ninety-five was adopted. 2025: A new first part of railway RAMS was published. These dates identify project events, guide reprints, or standards and research publications, rather than claiming that the lesson system first appeared then. For automatic-driving feedback from speed planning to stopping verification, the useful historical perspective is the expansion from individual equipment to evidence across interfaces. The course connects that perspective through comfortable acceleration transitions and automatic-operation service recovery. Reference projects guide observation only: hypothetical parameters are not field data, and historical editions do not automatically establish current local requirements.
